craft_notes: Sthāyin: rest-foretaste (awakening sealed, wheels opening). Sanskrit first: seal (awakening pointed), opening (wheel-resting), texture-series (petal, blaze, flow, sky) → L4 sets seal+opening line 1, texture line 2. Rows: row 2 (the four textures kept whole line 2 — never split, the series IS the rest). Rupture: colon after 'repose' — seal stamped, texture released. Close: end-weight on vastness ('still sky' — the widest word last). Minimal pass: dash-folded the series (petal — blazing, flowing) for breath; 'pose' cut for 'sky'. Read aloud: line 1 declares (declared/repose stressed), colon breath, line 2 floats (blazing/flowing/still long). Rejected: 'pose' rhyme kept — killed: rhyme-word needing no ground fails subset discipline; splitting textures — killed: easing what Sanskrit packs.

lines: This awakening stands declared. Now the wheels' repose:
a petal by nature — blazing, flowing, like the still sky.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etadbodhanam uddiṣṭaṃ cakraviśrāmaṇaṃ tataḥ / svābhāvikaṃ dalaṃ dīptaṃ dravaṃ sthiranabhopamam

reads_against.argmap: Awakening closed; wheel-resting opens as natural, blazing, flowing, sky-steady.
c1_essence: Awakening sealed; wheel-resting: petal, blaze, flow, steady sky.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta strained toward bhayānaka (wonder edged with fear)
